>     lines = f.readlines()

>     if line.strip():
>         parts = line.strip().split('\t')
>         nums = []
>         for part in parts:
>             sub = part.split(',')
>             nums.extend([int(sub[0]), int(sub[1])])
>         data.append(nums)
> arr = np.array(data)
> print('Data shape:', arr.shape)
>
> # Case 1: x = first column, y = second column
> x1 = arr[:, 0]
> y1 = arr[:, 1]
> print('\nCase 1: x = first column')
> print('x min:', x1.min(), 'x max:', x1.max())
> print('y min:', y1.min(), 'y max:', y1.max())
>
> # Find peaks in y1
> peaks, _ = find_peaks(y1, distance=10)
> print('Peaks indices:', peaks)
> print('Peak values:', y1[peaks])
> print('Peak x values:', x1[peaks])

> y2 = arr[:, 0]
